build.beforeDevCommand: npm run engine && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run engine && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Manage and verify compressed game stores
bundle.longDescription: Experimental source-preserving compressed game storage. Unsigned development builds require separate platform and per-game validation.
